veld-tq-balgevoel.naam: Ball mastery: sole rolls and drag-backs
veld-tq-balgevoel.uitleg: Everyone works in their own space with a ball. Roll the ball sideways back and forth with your sole, drag it back with your sole and push it forward again with the inside of your foot. Switch feet after a minute.
veld-tq-balgevoel.organisatie: Players spread out 3–4 m apart, each with a ball. The coach stands in front of the group and demonstrates.
coachpunten: Light on the balls of your feet, standing leg slightly bent
Sole on top of the ball, not against it
Look up as much as possible, not only at the ball
Practise with both left and right

moeilijker: Drag back and turn straight away
Combination: sole, inside, outside in one smooth sequence

veld-tq-aannemen-meenemen.naam: Receive and go through a gate
veld-tq-aannemen-meenemen.uitleg: A passes to B. With their first touch, B takes the ball diagonally forwards through the left or right gate behind them, turns and passes back. Then B picks the other gate. Swap roles after 6 goes.
veld-tq-aannemen-meenemen.organisatie: A and B stand 10 m apart. Behind B, 2.5 m to the left and right, is a gate of two disc cones (2 m wide).
coachpunten: Check over your shoulder before you receive: where is the space?
Receive with your back foot (stay open)
First touch firm enough to go straight through the gate

makkelijker: A rolls the ball by hand
moeilijker: Just before the first touch, the coach points to the left or right gate
A only calls 'left' or 'right' as they pass
Receive with the outside of the foot
An opponent behind B blocks one gate
After the gate, keep dribbling and finish on a mini goal

veld-tq-kappen-draaien.naam: Cuts and turns at the cone
veld-tq-kappen-draaien.uitleg: Dribble to the cone, turn just before it with a cut and accelerate back. A different turn each round: inside, outside, sole (drag-back) or Cruyff turn.
veld-tq-kappen-draaien.organisatie: An 8 m lane per player with a cone at the end; lanes 4 m apart. Everyone has a ball and starts at the same time.
coachpunten: Slow down with small steps just before the turn
Get low and keep your body between the ball and the cone
Accelerate straight after the turn: the first two metres matter most

makkelijker: Slow pace, turn at a line instead of a cone
moeilijker: Against the clock: 4 times there and back
A defender behind the cone who may tag you after the turn

veld-tq-schijnbeweging.uitleg: Dribble at the pole (the 'defender'). At 1.5 m, feint to the right (body and leg go with it, the ball stays where it is) and accelerate past on the left. Jog back round the outside with the ball and rejoin the queue.
veld-tq-schijnbeweging.organisatie: A pole 5 m from the start, with the end cone 3.5 m behind it. Players queue, each with a ball. The next one goes when the player ahead has passed the pole.
coachpunten: Feint 1–2 m from the defender: not too early, not too late
Sell it: shoulder and hip really go with it
After the feint, push the ball away with the other foot and accelerate

makkelijker: Show the movement without a ball first
moeilijker: A real defender who may only move after the feint
Finish on a mini goal after beating the defender

veld-tq-poortjesdribbel.uitleg: There are small gates in the area. Dribble through as many different gates as you can in 45 seconds; the same gate twice in a row doesn't count. Who gets the most gates?
veld-tq-poortjesdribbel.organisatie: 16 × 16 m area with 6 gates of two disc cones (1.5 m wide), placed randomly. Everyone has a ball.
coachpunten: Look up and choose your next gate in advance
Slow down and turn just after the gate, then accelerate
Small touches in crowded areas, bigger touches in open space

moeilijker: A different turn after each gate
Two players without a ball may 'guard' gates
After five gates, pass to the coach and get it back into your path

veld-tq-hooghouden.uitleg: Keep the ball up as many times in a row as you can with your foot (and later thigh and head). Count out loud and try to beat your record. Young players may let the ball bounce once in between.
veld-tq-hooghouden.organisatie: Everyone has a ball, well spread out (3–4 m apart). Blocks of 1 minute with a short rest in between.
coachpunten: Strike the ball with your laces, ankle extended
Soft touch: the ball shouldn't go higher than your hip
Standing leg slightly bent, eyes on the ball

makkelijker: Drop the ball from your hands, touch it once and catch it again
moeilijker: In pairs: take turns to touch it (keepy-ups together)
After ten keepy-ups, volley the ball at a mini goal

veld-tq-aannemen-uit-de-lucht.naam: Controlling the ball out of the air
veld-tq-aannemen-uit-de-lucht.uitleg: A throws the ball in an arc to B. B controls it out of the air (laces, thigh or chest), takes it a short way to the side and passes back along the ground. A varies the height. Swap roles after 8 goes.
veld-tq-aannemen-uit-de-lucht.organisatie: Pairs 6–7 m apart, one ball per pair.
coachpunten: Move towards the ball and read its flight early
Make the receiving surface 'soft': cushion it as you make contact
Take it in the direction you want to go

makkelijker: Let it bounce first, then control it
moeilijker: Take it to the side in one movement
A kicks the ball instead of throwing it
Volley or half-volley it straight back

veld-tq-indraaien.uitleg: The middle player comes short to A, receives the ball, opens up and turns towards C with one touch and passes to C. Then they come short to C, receive and turn again towards A. Change the middle player after 1 minute.
veld-tq-indraaien.organisatie: Three players in a line: A and C 20 m apart, the middle player halfway. A and C take turns to have the ball.
coachpunten: Move away from the ball first, then come short: that creates space
Check over your shoulder before you receive
Stay open and receive with your back foot

moeilijker: A passive defender behind the middle player
Turn with the outside of the foot
Play on straight after the turn (two touches in total)

veld-tq-koning-van-het-vak.uitleg: Everyone dribbles their own ball in the area. Protect your ball and meanwhile try to knock other players' balls out of the area. If your ball goes out, fetch it, do 5 keepy-ups or cuts outside the area and then join in again.
veld-tq-koning-van-het-vak.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area (smaller with fewer players). Everyone has a ball. Play in 1-minute blocks.
coachpunten: Body between opponent and ball (shield it)
Look up: where is the danger and where is a ball to win?
Ball close to your foot in crowded areas

makkelijker: One player without a ball is the 'hunter'
moeilijker: If you lose your ball you're out (last one left is king)
Dribble with your weaker foot only

veld-te-kleurenreactie-bal.uitleg: Two players stand in the middle with a ball at their feet, facing the coach. The coach calls a colour; both players dribble as fast as they can to that disc cone, turn round it with the ball and dribble back to the middle. First back with the ball under control wins a point.
veld-te-kleurenreactie-bal.organisatie: Four coloured disc cones 4 m around a centre point (front, back, left, right). The players stand 1.5–2 m apart in the middle with a ball; the coach is 6 m in front of them.
coachpunten: Look up at the coach, not at the ball
Small touches as you slow down, ball close to your foot
Turn with the ball (inside or outside) and accelerate back

makkelijker: The coach also points to the colour (see and hear)
Dribble at walking pace first, then sprint
moeilijker: The coach calls two colours in a row
First back may shoot at a mini goal

veld-tq-aannemen-onder-druk.uitleg: The server plays the ball in to the receiver. At the same time a defender closes them down from the side. The receiver takes their first touch away from the pressure and plays the ball through the gate on that side to a teammate. Then the defender comes from the other side and the receiver turns the other way.
veld-tq-aannemen-onder-druk.organisatie: Server with balls 10 m in front of the receiver. Behind the receiver, two 4 m gates (left and right) with a teammate beyond each. The defender starts 6 m to the side of the receiver. Rotate after a few balls.
coachpunten: Before the ball arrives: check where the defender is coming from
First touch away from the pressure, with the foot furthest from the defender
Look up straight after the first touch and play it on

moeilijker: The defender chooses which side to come from
Play it on in two touches maximum
The pass comes in the air

veld-mt-verkeerslicht.uitleg: You are cars and the ball is your car. On green you drive around: dribble! On orange you put your foot on the ball. On red you sit on your ball. Listen carefully!
veld-mt-verkeerslicht.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with a disc cone on each corner, for 5 children, each with a ball. The coach stands at the side and calls green, orange or red. Play for 15 minutes in short rounds with the odd drinks break.
coachpunten: Keep the ball close to your foot
Look up: where is the coach?

makkelijker: The coach shows each task first
moeilijker: The coach calls faster and faster

veld-mt-hondje-uitlaten.uitleg: Your ball is your dog. Don’t let it run away: it stays close to you! When the coach calls "sit", put your foot on the ball. On "turn around" you go the other way. On "run" you and your dog go a bit faster.
veld-mt-hondje-uitlaten.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with a disc cone on each corner, for 5 children, each with a ball. The coach calls the commands. Play for 15 minutes; let the children think of a command too.
coachpunten: Small touches: your dog stays close

moeilijker: "Paw": touch the ball with your other foot

veld-mt-brandweer.uitleg: You are firefighters driving calmly through the town. When the coach shouts "fire!", drive as fast as you can to a hoop and stop your ball in it. Who is the first to stand still?
veld-mt-brandweer.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with 5 hoops around the edges, for 5 children, each with a ball. Everyone dribbles freely. On "fire!" each child stops their ball in a hoop. Play for 15 minutes in short rounds.
coachpunten: Stop the ball with the sole of your foot

veld-mt-kleurenpoortjes.uitleg: There are gates in lovely colours everywhere. Dribble around. When the coach calls "red", take your ball through a red gate. Then listen again: which colour is next?
veld-mt-kleurenpoortjes.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with 4 gates of disc cones (2 m wide), each gate its own colour, for 5 children, each with a ball. The coach calls a colour. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look up: where is your colour?
Keep the ball close through the gate

moeilijker: The coach calls two colours in a row

veld-mt-onder-de-brug.uitleg: The hurdle is a bridge. Dribble to it and gently roll your ball underneath. Step over the bridge yourself and take your ball with you again. Can you do it without touching the bridge?
veld-mt-onder-de-brug.organisatie: Three lanes side by side, each with a high hurdle and a cone as the start 5 m away. For 5 children, each with a ball, at most 2 per lane. After the hurdle, dribble back around the outside. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Tap it softly so the ball rolls calmly under the bridge

makkelijker: Roll the ball under the bridge by hand

veld-mt-huisjes.uitleg: Every hoop is a little house. Dribble around. When the coach calls "go home!", take your ball to a house. But watch out: a house disappears each time. Then you have to share a house!
veld-mt-huisjes.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with 5 hoops spread out, for 5 children, each with a ball. After each round the coach takes one hoop away, until 2 are left. Then start again. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look up: which house is free?
Sharing is good

makkelijker: Each child keeps their own house
moeilijker: First a lap around the hoop, then in

veld-mt-door-het-bos.uitleg: The cones are trees in the forest. Dribble in and out between the trees. Careful: you mustn’t touch a tree! How many trees can you pass?
veld-mt-door-het-bos.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with 9 cones spread out (about 3 m apart), for 5 children, each with a ball. Everyone dribbles at the same time: nobody is waiting. Play for 15 minutes in short rounds.
coachpunten: Small touches between the trees
Look where you are going

veld-mt-tik-tak.uitleg: Your feet are a clock: tick-tock, tick-tock! Tap the ball gently from one foot to the other. Copy the coach. Can you do it standing still? Then try it while walking!
veld-mt-tik-tak.organisatie: Children in a line facing the coach, 2 m apart, each with a ball. First copy the coach standing still, then walking over 6 m. For 5 children; nobody waits. Play for 15 minutes with breaks.
coachpunten: Tap with the inside of your foot
Softly: the ball stays between your feet

makkelijker: First a still ball, feet on it in turns

veld-mt-rondje-pion.uitleg: Let’s have a race! Dribble as fast as you can to the cone, go around it and come back. Tag the next child: now it’s their turn. Which line finishes first?
veld-mt-rondje-pion.organisatie: Two lines of 2–3 children, 3 m apart, each with a cone 6 m away. Everyone has a ball. The next child starts when the first is back. Play for 15 minutes, with a new race each time.
coachpunten: Go calmly around the cone, keep the ball close

makkelijker: No race: everyone at their own pace
moeilijker: Go left and right around the cone

veld-mt-eieren-rapen.uitleg: There are eggs on the cones: they are the tennis balls. Dribble your ball to a cone, pick up an egg and dribble with it to your own hoop. Put the egg carefully in your nest. Who has the most eggs?
veld-mt-eieren-rapen.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with 6 tall cones in the middle, each with a tennis ball on top, and a hoop for each child at the edge. For 5 children, each with a ball. One egg at a time. Play for 15 minutes; keep putting the eggs back.
coachpunten: Your ball stays with you, even with an egg in your hand

makkelijker: No ball: just collect the eggs

veld-mt-ladder-en-dribbel.uitleg: First go through the ladder without a ball: small, quick steps! Your ball is waiting at the end. Take it with your foot and dribble around the tall cone and back. Who has finished?
veld-mt-ladder-en-dribbel.organisatie: Two lanes side by side: a speed ladder, 1 m further on a ball, and 4 m after that a tall cone. For 5 children, at most 2–3 per line. After the cone, dribble back and leave the ball for the next child. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Small steps in the ladder
Go calmly around the cone

makkelijker: One step in each box, walking
moeilijker: Go left and right around the cone

veld-mt-poppenslalom.uitleg: Look at those big mannequins. Dribble around them, first past one side and then the other, like a snake. Don’t touch them!
veld-mt-poppenslalom.organisatie: Two lanes, each with 3 mannequins 2.5 m apart. For 5 children, each with a ball, at most 2–3 per line. Dribble back around the outside. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Small touches, with both feet

veld-mt-kaatsbordpassjes.uitleg: Play the ball against the rebound board. It comes back! Stop it with the bottom of your foot. Count along: who can get to 5?
veld-mt-kaatsbordpassjes.organisatie: One rebound board for every 2 children; each child 3 m from the board, side by side or taking turns. For 5 children, 3 rebound boards. Play for 15 minutes; keep changing foot.
coachpunten: Stop the ball with the sole of your foot
Stay calm: play it softly

makkelijker: Stop the ball first, then play it

veld-mt-kleurenpionnen.uitleg: There are brightly coloured cones everywhere. When the coach calls "yellow", dribble to a yellow cone and touch it with your ball. Then come back to the middle. Which colour is next?
veld-mt-kleurenpionnen.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with 4 tall cones in 4 colours on the sides (disc cones work too), for 5 children, each with a ball in the middle. The coach calls a colour. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look up and listen carefully
Keep the ball close to you

moeilijker: Touch it with your other foot

veld-mt-palenpoort.uitleg: Two poles make a tunnel. Dribble through the tunnel, turn around and come back through it. How many times can you do it without touching the poles?
veld-mt-palenpoort.organisatie: Three tunnels of 2 poles (1.5 m wide), with 1–2 children per tunnel, each with a ball. For 5 children. After the tunnel, turn 2 m further on and come back. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Turn with the ball at your foot

veld-mt-hoedjes-omdraaien.uitleg: We play in two teams. Team red turns the disc cones upside down. Team blue turns them back. Dribble your ball to a disc cone and flip it. Who has the most after 1 minute?
veld-mt-hoedjes-omdraaien.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with 10 disc cones spread out: half of them are upside down. For 5 children: 2 against 3, each with a ball; the coach helps the smaller team. Rounds of 1 minute, count and start again. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Take your ball with you, don’t leave it
Look up: where is a disc cone?

moeilijker: Flip them using only your foot

veld-mt-hoedjes-verzamelen.uitleg: There are disc cones everywhere. Dribble to a disc cone, pick it up and take it to your own hoop. Got lots of them? Then take them back one at a time!
veld-mt-hoedjes-verzamelen.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area with 12 disc cones spread out and a hoop for each child at the edge. For 5 children, each with a ball. First collect all the disc cones, then take them back one at a time. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Ball at your foot, disc cone in your hand

makkelijker: Disc cones closer to the hoop
moeilijker: Only disc cones in your colour

veld-tq-pop-actie.naam: Dribble to the mannequin and make a move
veld-tq-pop-actie.uitleg: Dribble at pace to the mannequin. Make a move just before it, then accelerate with the ball to the cone behind the mannequin. Change the move each round: the step-over (foot over the ball, then go the other way), a body feint (body one way, ball the other) or the Cruyff turn (fake shot, drag the ball behind your standing leg and turn away).
veld-tq-pop-actie.organisatie: Three lanes side by side, 8 m apart. Per lane a mannequin 7.5 m after the start and a cone 4.5 m behind the mannequin. Every player has a ball. After the cone, dribble back round the outside and rejoin. Change lane or move after each round.
coachpunten: Start your move 1.5 m from the mannequin, not right on top of it
After the move, pace matters most: first two steps explosive
Keep the ball close and look up

makkelijker: A cone instead of a mannequin and one move per round
moeilijker: The coach calls the move just before the mannequin
Make the move with your other foot

veld-tq-slalom-bal.uitleg: Dribble the ball in a slalom through the cones. Play it a different way each round: inside only, outside only, or with the sole. Use both your left and your right foot. Turn at the last cone and come back with your other foot.
veld-tq-slalom-bal.organisatie: Two lanes side by side, 8 m apart. Per lane 5 cones in a row, 2.5 m apart. Divide the players over the lanes, each with a ball. The next player starts when the previous one reaches the third cone.
coachpunten: Lots of small touches: the ball stays close to your foot
Between touches, look ahead to the next cone
Low through the knees, push off after each turn

makkelijker: Minis: only with your best foot

veld-tq-vierkant-wendingen.uitleg: Four cones in a square. Dribble from cone to cone and make a different turn at each one: with the inside, with the outside, with the sole and the Cruyff turn. Accelerate to the next cone after each turn. After a lap, turn round and go the other way.
veld-tq-vierkant-wendingen.organisatie: Square of 9 × 9 m with a cone on each corner. With bigger groups, use more squares. Two players per square, each with a ball, on opposite corners. They start at the same time and go the same way round.
coachpunten: Brake with small steps and make the turn low through the knees
Take the ball into the new direction in one movement
Look up and accelerate straight after the turn

makkelijker: One type of turn per round

veld-tq-tempowisseling.uitleg: Dribble slowly to the first line. There, accelerate as fast as you can to the next line, chop the ball and dribble back slowly. It is all about the difference: really slow first, then really fast.
veld-tq-tempowisseling.organisatie: Three lanes side by side. The first line is 5 m after the start, the second line 8 m further on. Mark the lines with disc cones next to the lanes. Every player has a ball; each lane starts in turn.
coachpunten: Slow pace: ball close to your foot, look up
Accelerating: play the ball a little further ahead and take big strides
Brake with small steps before you chop

makkelijker: Minis: walk, then run, and stop at the line with your foot on the ball
moeilijker: Accelerate again straight after the chop

veld-tq-actie-passieve-verdediger.naam: Dribble and move against a passive defender
veld-tq-actie-passieve-verdediger.uitleg: The defender stands still or only moves along, and does not win the ball. The dribbler goes at the defender, makes a move and gets past with a burst of speed to the line. Then swap roles. The defender goes with the move, so the dribbler learns when it works.
veld-tq-actie-passieve-verdediger.organisatie: Pairs with one ball. Per pair a 12 m lane: the defender stands halfway, the dribbler starts at the end. Behind the defender is a line of disc cones. Swap after five attempts.
coachpunten: Go straight at the defender, so he has to stop
Make the move from 1.5 to 2 m away
Go past the defender at an angle straight after the move and accelerate

makkelijker: A mannequin or cone instead of a defender
moeilijker: The defender may take one step towards the ball
The dribbler chooses a side at the last moment
After the line, sprint 5 m more with the defender chasing

veld-tq-spiegeldribbel.uitleg: Two players face each other, each with a ball. The leader makes a move with the ball: dribbling, chopping, a step-over or using the sole. The other copies it straight away, as in a mirror. Swap after a minute.
veld-tq-spiegeldribbel.organisatie: Pairs 6 m apart, in their own 6 × 10 m area. Each has a ball. With an odd number the coach joins in.
coachpunten: Watch your partner, not the ball
Leader: start slowly and make it harder and harder
Follower: stay as close to the leader as you can
